verdict.rationale: Runpod documents several headless automation paths. The open-source runpodctl CLI has scriptable commands such as `runpodctl pod create --name NAME --gpu-id ... --image ...` for managing Pods, endpoints, templates and volumes. A REST API v1 is explicitly positioned for 'workflows, and automation systems', with API-key authentication. There are also GraphQL and Python/JS/Go Serverless SDKs. Missing for 10: no CI-specific guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or non-interactive auth examples), no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and no independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
